cloud_chicken.name: Cloud Chicken
cloud_chicken.description: Your first farm companion. Happy, fed and clean hens produce one egg daily; assigned hens recover a herb seed.

duck.name: Cloud Duck
duck.description: Waters one planted farm bed on the next morning when assigned and cared for.

pig.name: Root Pig
pig.description: Assigned happy pigs find one building stone per day.

cow.name: Meadow Cow
cow.description: Assigned cows recover one botanical seed daily.

water_dragon.name: Water Dragon
water_dragon.description: Waters at most two already-planted beds; never tills, plants or harvests.

fire_dragon.name: Fire Dragon
fire_dragon.description: Adds one daily progress to existing egg/craft queues, capped at two total.

ice_dragon.name: Ice Dragon
ice_dragon.description: Improves forage preservation and lowers care decay when assigned.

forest_dragon.name: Forest Dragon
forest_dragon.description: Recovers one herb seed per cared day for the medicinal garden.

gold_dragon.name: Gold Dragon
gold_dragon.description: Collects one crystal per cared day; does not mint coins.

shadow_dragon.name: Shadow Dragon
shadow_dragon.description: Resists disease for the farm's companions.

crystal_dragon.name: Crystal Dragon
crystal_dragon.description: Provides preservation utility; requires rare crystal egg.

rainbow_dragon.name: Rainbow Dragon
rainbow_dragon.description: Late collection target and capped incubation utility; no unlimited economy buff.

silver_fish.name: Silver Fish
silver_fish.description: Produces low-value silver scales for recipes.

koi.name: Koi
koi.description: Calming pond companion with disease-resistance utility.

gold_fish.name: Gold Fish
gold_fish.description: Provides modest crafting materials instead of crop-level coin income.

slime.name: Garden Slime
slime.description: Assigned slimes recover one medicinal seed daily.

golem.name: Stone Golem
golem.description: Assigned golems gather one stone per day.

snake.name: Herbal Serpent
snake.description: Its assigned utility prevents neglect disease once basic care is adequate.
